info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Retrieval API enables consumers to access detailed routing information for rideshare services. This endpoint provides users with essential data on available routes, enhancing the rideshare experience by improving route planning and optimization. Typical users include app developers and transportation companies seeking to integrate efficient routing capabilities into their platforms. By leveraging this API, businesses can offer more reliable and streamlined rideshare services to their customers.

get.description: Fetch detailed route information for rides, including start and end locations, estimated travel time, and distance. This endpoint helps riders and drivers understand the optimal path for their journey.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the route information for rides. It includes parameters necessary for the calculation of the route based on user inputs, ensuring accurate results relevant to the requested ride service.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested route information.
